name: Dal Bloodclaw's Skull
summary: In northern Ashenvale, Raene Wolfrunner awaits proof that Astranaar is safe from attack. Dal Bloodclaw's Skull carries that proof.

sections.title: A Chieftain's Downfall
sections.body: The Thistlefur furbolgs north of Astranaar have grown more numerous and aggressive. Like much of Ashenvale's ancient forest, they have fallen to corruption. Raene Wolfrunner, a night elf sentinel, fears they will soon march on Astranaar. So she orders their ranks culled and their leader, Dal Bloodclaw, slain. His skull proves their chieftain is dead and buys Astranaar's defenders time.

faq.answer: Dal Bloodclaw led the Thistlefur furbolgs at Thistlefur Hold, just north of Astranaar. Under his leadership, the hostile tribe grew rapidly and threatened the nearby night elf outpost.

faq.q: Why does Raene Wolfrunner want the skull?
faq.answer: Raene Wolfrunner wants proof that the Thistlefur chieftain is dead. The night elves hope the surviving furbolgs will fall into disarray and lose any organized plans to attack Astranaar.

faq.q: Why are the Thistlefur furbolgs so hostile?
faq.answer: Like many furbolg tribes in Ashenvale, the Thistlefurs have succumbed to corruption spreading through the forest. They have grown violent and territorial, threatening those who once lived beside them.

angles.text: As a night elf, you may grieve when fallen furbolg leaders are defeated. Corruption has twisted these ancient allies, and now they threaten settlements such as Astranaar.
As an Alliance member, you help secure Astranaar's northern flank. The settlement is the Alliance's main sanctuary in central Ashenvale.
